problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: volume 48 cubic feet
* Package 2: volume 61 cubic feet
* Package 3: volume 45 cubic feet
* Package 4: volume 70 cubic feet
* Package 5: volume 34 cubic feet
* Package 6: volume 47 cubic feet

* Package 19: volume 54 cubic feet
* Package 20: volume 59 cubic feet

* Package 22: volume 40 cubic feet
* Package 23: volume 32 cubic feet
* Package 24: volume 40 cubic feet
* Package 25: volume 30 cubic feet
* Package 26: volume 63 cubic feet
* Package 27: volume 55 cubic feet
* Package 28: volume 52 cubic feet
* Package 29: volume 35 cubic feet
* Package 30: volume 50 cubic feet
* Package 31: volume 31 cubic feet
* Package 32: volume 59 cubic feet
* Package 33: volume 62 cubic feet
* Package 34: volume 44 cubic feet
* Package 35: volume 46 cubic feet

Each truck can carry up to 100 cubic feet of cargo. Load all packages using the fewest trucks. Each package must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total volume in a truck cannot exceed its capacity.
